title: Lugaru
tagline: A rabbit with a sword, a village in ashes, and wolves who keep slaves.
summary: Lugaru: The Rabbit's Foot (Wolfire Games, 2005) is a third-person 3D martial-arts action game. Turner, a retired rabbit warrior, follows the raiders who destroyed his village across grassland, snow and desert, then finds the wolf pack behind them. Fights are context-sensitive: punch, kick, sweep, throw, draw a knife, sword or staff, crouch under a high attack to reverse it, and cut a throat from behind.

This port is built from the open-source Lugaru 1.3.0-dev tree (WolfireGames/lugaru, commit 6a58b62) and uses its models, skeleton, animations, terrain, textures, sound effects, 27-level main campaign, level data and dialogue. The renderer is three.js, the character deformation is the original muscle/skeleton system, and the damage numbers, animation labels, height rules and AI sight ranges come from the original source.

The data is Wolfire's CC BY-SA 3.0, shipped alongside the GPL-3.0 port as a separate work. The operator approved this arrangement on 2026-11-21 (variant B). Deliberately not shipped: the five music tracks (provenance undocumented), the OSS Temple campaign and its AR PL UKai-derived textures, the SIL OFL console font, and the separate HD texture pack. See LICENSE.md.

original.author: David Rosen / Wolfire Games; OSS Lugaru contributors
original.platform: Mac OS X, Windows, Linux (C++, SDL, OpenGL)
original.license: GPL-2.0-or-later (code); CC-BY-SA-3.0 (Wolfire data, shipped separately); no music/Temple/OFL font/HD pack

controls.input: W A S D / arrow keys
controls.action: Run, walk and turn (the character faces the movement direction)
Look; click the game once to capture the pointer, right-drag to look without capture
Attack: punch, kick, knife, sword or staff; crouched, a sweep or a stealth kill from behind
Crouch / sneak; crouch under a high attack to reverse it
Pause; from the pause menu back to the site

caveat: The 27-level Wolfire campaign, movement, fights and the original data are here; the music, Temple/Empire/Seven Tasks campaigns, console font and HD pack are deliberately not shipped. Ragdoll physics, wall jumps, mid-level dialogue/hotspots, hearing/smell AI and some reversals are simplified; README.md lists every deviation.
